title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots
grouping: Two sections split by a thick grey horizontal rule, titled in bold 'A) Training in Simulation' and 'B) Deployment'. Section A holds two light-grey bands with dark-grey tab labels 'Phase 1' and 'Phase 2'; section B one band. Each band is a left-to-right chain: input boxes -> trapezoid encoder -> small latent box (z_t or ẑ_t) -> trapezoid base policy -> a_t. The environment sits outside the bands at the right: a rendered quadruped on faceted terrain captioned 'Physics Simulation' for training, a photo of the real robot on a forest path for deployment. A red note '*Trainable Modules in Red' sits under Phase 1.
shapes_depth: Flat, white-filled rounded boxes with thick black outlines for inputs (x_t, a_t-1; a stack x_t-51 ... x_t-1 with a vertical ellipsis; a box listing 'Mass, COM, Friction / Terrain Height / Motor Strength (e_t)'). Networks are trapezoids narrowing toward the latent and widening into the policy. Math labels are serif italic. Dashed black arrows close the loop: from a_t into the environment picture and from the picture by long dashed elbows back to the observation boxes of both phases. A green double-headed arrow labelled 'Regress' in grey joins z_t and ẑ_t across the two bands. Deployment boxes carry rates ('10 Hz', '100 Hz').
proposed_highlight: Trainable modules in each phase (Env Factor Encoder and Base Policy in phase 1, Adaptation Module in phase 2) have red outlines, frozen ones black, explained by the red footnote; deployment repeats the same modules all in black.
lesson: Close the agent-environment loop with dashed arrows from a_t through a picture of the environment - a simulator render in training, a real photo at deployment - back to the observation boxes, and outline only the modules trained in that phase in red.
notes: Venue RSS from Semantic Scholar (title match, venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2021 = S2 year and arXiv year. Simulator render and real photo are embedded rasters.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
